in_marathi.name: Aryanraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aryanraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aryan refers to noble, superior or ruler. Raj means rule or kingdom. This name is derived from the ancient Sanskrit language and is a popular choice in Hindu communities.
